# awscc_bcmpricingcalculator_bill_estimate (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::BcmPricingCalculator::BillEstimate



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the bill estimate.
- `bill_estimate_id` (String) The unique identifier of the bill estimate
- `bill_interval` (Attributes) The time period covered by the bill estimate (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bill_interval))
- `bill_scenario_id` (String) The unique identifier of the bill scenario this estimate is based on
- `cost_category_group_sharing_preference_arn` (String) The ARN of the cost category group sharing preference
- `cost_category_group_sharing_preference_effective_date` (String) The effective date of the cost category group sharing preference
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the bill estimate was created
- `expires_at` (String) The timestamp when the bill estimate expires
- `group_sharing_preference` (String) The group sharing preference for the bill estimate
- `name` (String) The name of the bill estimate
- `status` (String) The status of the bill estimate
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
